descriptions.value: This item commemorates the 2017 ELEAGUE Atlanta CS:GO Championship.
It was dropped during the Group Stage match between Natus Vincere and mousesports, and autographed by Oleksandr Kostyliev who was the most valuable player in that round.

High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. It has been custom painted with a knotwork dragon. 200 keys could never unlock its secrets
Sticker: Natus Vincere (Gold) | Atlanta 2017, mousesports (Gold) | Atlanta 2017, s1mple (Gold) | Atlanta 2017, ELEAGUE (Gold) | Atlanta 2017

descriptions.value: With its curved blade mimicking a tiger's claw, the karambit was developed as part of the southeast Asian martial discipline of silat. The knife is typically used with a reverse grip, with the finger ring on the index finger. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated. Getting lost in its color can prove fatal
